newsitem.title: UK: Levi Strauss appoints agencies for Asia.
newsitem.headline: Levi Strauss appoints agencies for Asia.

text.p: Jeans company Levi Strauss & Co said on Thursday that it had appointed advertising agencies Bartle Bogle Hegarty (BBH) and McCann-Erickson to run campaigns for its Asia-Pacific division.
BBH will manage pan-regional strategy and create advertising concepts for Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Indonesia, the Philippines, India, Australia and New Zealand. The budget has not been disclosed.
McCann-Erickson will be responsible for media planning and buying for the region.
BBH already handles the account in the UK and Europe and some of its campaigns have been aired globally.

"BBH's track record for developing effective and award winning creative work provides a platform for the Levi's brand to become the apparel brand of choice for consumers in Asia," said Patricia Royak vice president of marketing for Levi Strauss' Asia Pacific division.
The company is currently building the Levi jeans brand in Asia.

"We are preparing to take the business for jeans wear and casual apparel to the next level in Asia. It is imperative that we develop relationships with those who understand the soul of our brands as well as our target consumers," said Royak.
Last year BBH set up an office in Singapore to allow it to work with existing clients who have interests in Asia and to attract new clients.
Simon Sherwood, managing director of BBH Asia-Pacific said, "We are delighted with this appointment and it vindicates our setting up in the region."
BBH's "clayman" campaign, which features an animated clay figure, was shown globally last year and won a TV viewers poll in Singapore where it was voted favourite ad.
